title: Staff training pilot
summary: [00:00-00:42] Pilot format — Participant A proposes a small pilot of project-handoff training; the forty-five-minute session would involve around six volunteers working through a fictional handoff and discussing missing information • [00:42-01:19] Practice activity — Participant B asks whether staff performance is being assessed; Participant A clarifies that the pilot tests the training materials, and Participant C suggests calling the exercise a practice activity • [01:19-01:47] Materials — Participant C will send an optional outline beforehand and make printed materials available during the session • [01:47-02:18] Preparation & review — Participant B will prepare the activity and answer guide by Friday afternoon for Participant A to review Monday • [02:18-02:43] Feedback — Participant A says feedback will focus on which parts are clear and what needs improvement • [02:43-03:25] Scheduling & rollout — Participant C will use an availability form to choose between two Wednesday time slots; Participant A confirms that no wider rollout has been planned
